usage: icebath debug [-h] {share,delete} ...

Debug utilities for Icebath Agent. Use 'icebath debug share' to upload a debug report (system info + recent logs) to a paste service and get a shareable URL.

positional arguments:
  {share,delete}
    share         Upload debug report to a paste service and print a shareable URL
    delete        Delete a paste uploaded by 'icebath debug share'

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit

Examples:
    icebath debug share              Upload debug report (asks for confirmation)
    icebath debug share --yes        Skip confirmation (for scripts/CI)
    icebath debug share --lines 500  Include more log lines
    icebath debug share --expire 30  Keep dpaste.com fallback pastes for 30 days
    icebath debug share --local      Print report locally (no upload)
    icebath debug share --no-redact  Disable upload-time secret redaction
    icebath debug share --nous       Upload to Nous-internal storage (private)
    icebath debug delete <url>       Delete a previously uploaded paste
